subject: Add Phase 1 unit tests
description:
Create tests for all Phase 1 foundation components:

Test files to create:
- `tests/conftest.py` — Mock hdbcli fixtures (mock connection, mock cursor, mock pool)
- `tests/test_config.py` — Configuration loading, env var parsing, auto-TLS, cascading env files
- `tests/test_pool.py` — Pool acquire/release, timeout, health checks, dispose
- `tests/test_cli.py` — CLI test/serve commands with mocked dependencies

Key fixtures in `conftest.py`:
- `mock_hdbcli_connection`: Mock PEP 249 connection with cursor support
- `mock_cursor`: Mock cursor with `fetchall`, `fetchone`, `description`, `execute`
- `mock_pool`: Mock connection pool for tool/service tests
- `hana_config`: Test configuration with safe defaults

All tests must:
- Use pytest asyncio auto mode
- Mock hdbcli (no real HANA connection needed)
- Follow existing monorepo test patterns

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `conftest.py` provides reusable mock fixtures for hdbcli
- [ ] `test_config.py` covers all config loading scenarios
- [ ] `test_pool.py` covers pool lifecycle and error scenarios
- [ ] `test_cli.py` covers test and serve command paths
- [ ] All tests pass with `pytest packages/mamba-mcp-hana/`

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Test config with hdbuserstore key (no user/password)
- [ ] Test pool timeout and dead connection recovery

**Testing Requirements:**
• Target: >80% coverage for Phase 1 modules
• All tests mock hdbcli — no real HANA dependency

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 9.1, 3.2
